description: A run of exactly one test file, with no --verbose, under Jest 30.5.2 (T9.7, B21c): `@jest/core`'s runJest turns verbose on by itself when `allTests.length === 1` unless `--silent` or `verbose: false`, so the default run lists the file's tests under their describe titles (check, circle for skipped, pencil for todo; skipped and todo after the others), a blank line after the list, and prints the console block before the header, as `--verbose` does (report-verbose). One Jest worker. A black-box run.
